SELECT S.SMP_CD ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR, S.SMP_CHASU)+'차' AS SMP_CHASU ,S.ITEM_CD ,I.ITEM_NM ,S.CUST_CD ,C.CUST_NM ,S.EUSER_CD ,C2.CUST_NM AS EUSER_NM ,S.DSTR_TYPE ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', S.DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM ,S.DEPT_CD ,D.DEPT_NM ,S.USER_CD ,U.USER_NM ,S.MUSER_CD ,U2.USER_NM AS MUSER_NM ,S.BIZ_TYPE ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', S.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM ,S.SMP_STATUS ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SMP_STATUS', S.SMP_STATUS) AS SMP_STATUS_NM ,S.PRDT_PSBLT ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'PRDT_PSBLT', S.PRDT_PSBLT) AS PRDT_PSBLT_NM ,CONVERT(DATE,S.SMP_RDATE) AS SMP_RDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.PRDT_RCDATE) AS PRDT_RCDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.CMPT_RDATE) AS CMPT_RDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.PRDT_RDATE) AS PRDT_RDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.PRDT_ADATE) AS PRDT_ADATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.PRDT_PDATE) AS PRDT_PDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.PRDT_CDATE) AS PRDT_CDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.SHIP_PDATE) AS SHIP_PDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.FILM_FDATE) AS FILM_FDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,S.FILM_RDATE) AS FILM_RDATE ,S.PJT_CD ,P.PJT_NM ,I.ITEM_TYPE ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ITEM_TYPE', I.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE_NM ,ISNULL(C.BAD_AR_YN,'N') BAD_AR_YN FROM T_SAMPLE S LEFT OUTER JOIN T_ITEM I ON S.COMPANY_CD = I.COMPANY_CD AND S.ITEM_CD = I.ITEM_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER C ON S.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND S.CUST_CD = C.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CUSTOMER C2 ON S.COMPANY_CD = C2.COMPANY_CD AND S.EUSER_CD = C2.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT D ON S.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND S.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER U ON S.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND S.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER U2 ON S.COMPANY_CD = U2.COMPANY_CD AND S.MUSER_CD = U2.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_PROJECT P ON S.COMPANY_CD = P.COMPANY_CD AND S.PJT_CD = P.PJT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CODE CD ON S.SMP_STATUS = CD.CODE_ID
WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND S.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND S.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND S.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND S.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND S.USER_CD = #user_nm#
AND S.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND S.SMP_RDATE >= REPLACE(#sdate#,'-','')
AND S.SMP_RDATE <= REPLACE(#edate#,'-','')
AND S.PRDT_RDATE >= REPLACE(#s_prdt_rdate#,'-','')
AND S.PRDT_RDATE <= REPLACE(#e_prdt_rdate#,'-','')
AND S.PRDT_ADATE >= REPLACE(#s_prdt_adate#,'-','')
AND S.PRDT_ADATE <= REPLACE(#e_prdt_adate#,'-','')
AND S.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
AND (S.CUST_CD LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%' OR C.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%') AND S.CUST_CD IS NOT NULL
AND S.BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type#
AND S.MUSER_CD = #muser_nm#
AND S.SMP_STATUS = #smp_status#
AND S.PRDT_PSBLT = #prdt_psblt#
AND S.EUSER_CD = #end_user_cd#
AND (S.EUSER_CD LIKE '%' + #end_user_nm# + '%' OR C2.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #end_user_nm# + '%') AND S.EUSER_CD IS NOT NULL
AND S.PJT_CD = #pjt_cd#
AND (S.PJT_CD LIKE '%' + #pjt_nm# + '%' OR P.PJT_NM LIKE '%' + #pjt_nm# + '%') AND P.PJT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND S.MUSER_CD = #muser_cd#
AND S.PRDT_AUSER = #prdt_auser#
AND CD.UP_CODE_ID = 'SMP_STATUS' AND CD.VALUE_2 = 'Y'
AND CD.UP_CODE_ID = 'SMP_STATUS' AND CD.VALUE_3 = 'Y'
AND S.SMP_STATUS IS NOT NULL
AND I.ITEM_TYPE = #item_type# AND S.ITEM_CD IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY S.SMP_CD DESC,S.SMP_CHASU DESC

,MUSER_CD ,DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(MUSER_CD) AS MUSER_NM ,MDEPT_CD ,DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(MDEPT_CD) AS MDEPT_NM ,SMP_STATUS ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SMP_STATUS',SMP_STATUS) AS SMP_STATUS_NM ,PRDT_PSBLT ,DBO.FN_GET_CODE_VALUE_NM('PRDT_PSBLT',PRDT_PSBLT,'1') AS PRDT_PSBLT_VALUE_NM ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'PRDT_PSBLT',PRDT_PSBLT) AS PRDT_PSBLT_NM ,CONVERT(DATE,SMP_RDATE) AS SMP_RDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,PRDT_RCDATE) AS PRDT_RCDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,CMPT_RDATE) AS CMPT_RDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,PRDT_RDATE) AS PRDT_RDATE ,PRDT_RUSER ,DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(PRDT_RUSER) AS PRDT_RUSER_NM ,CONVERT(DATE,PRDT_ADATE) AS PRDT_ADATE ,PRDT_AUSER ,DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(PRDT_AUSER) AS PRDT_AUSER_NM ,CONVERT(DATE,PRDT_PDATE) AS PRDT_PDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,PRDT_CDATE) AS PRDT_CDATE ,PRDT_CUSER ,DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(PRDT_CUSER) AS PRDT_CUSER_NM ,CONVERT(DATE,SHIP_PDATE) AS SHIP_PDATE ,SHIP_PUSER ,DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(SHIP_PUSER) AS SHIP_PUSER_NM ,SMP_SUMRY ,BASE_CRNY ,EXCH_RATE ,BASE_YR ,SMP_QTY ,SMP_TYPE ,PRDT_CMT ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SMP_TYPE',SMP_TYPE) AS SMP_TYPE_NM ,CONVERT(DATE,FILM_FDATE) AS FILM_FDATE ,CONVERT(DATE,FILM_RDATE) AS FILM_RDATE ,DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(FILM_RUSER) T_SAMPLE.COMPANY_CD AND SMP_CD = T_SAMPLE.SMP_CD AND SMP_CHASU = T_SAMPLE.SMP_CHASU ) SMP_MY_RE_YN ,( SELECT (CASE WHEN ISNULL(COUNT(*),0) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) FROM T_SMP_RETURN WHERE COMPANY_CD = T_SAMPLE.COMPANY_CD AND SMP_CD = T_SAMPLE.SMP_CD AND SMP_CHASU = T_SAMPLE.SMP_CHASU ) SMP_RT_YN ,SMR_CD ,SMR_CHASU
FROM T_SAMPLE WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND SMP_CD = #smp_cd#
AND SMP_CD = #search_smp_cd#
AND SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu#

SELECT D.COMPANY_CD, D.SMP_CD, D.SMP_CHASU, CONVERT(DATE,D.SMP_DRDATE) AS SMP_DRDATE, S.ITEM_CD, I.ITEM_NM, S.CUST_CD, C.CUST_NM, S.EUSER_CD, C2.CUST_NM AS EUSER_NM, S.DSTR_TYPE, CD1.CODE_NM AS DSTR_TYPE_NM, D.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, U.DEPT_CD, DP.DEPT_NM, D.SMP_DRTYPE, CD3.CODE_NM AS SMP_DRTYPE_NM, S.BIZ_TYPE, CD2.CODE_NM AS BIZ_TYPE_NM, I.ITEM_TYPE, CD4.CODE_NM AS ITEM_TYPE_NM, CONVERT(DATE,S.SMP_RDATE) AS SMP_RDATE, CONVERT(DATE,S.CMPT_RDATE) AS CMPT_RDATE, CONVERT(DATE,S.PRDT_CDATE) AS PRDT_CDATE, CONVERT(DATE,S.SHIP_PDATE) AS SHIP_PDATE, C.BAD_AR_YN, SMP_DRDESCRIPT FROM (SELECT COMPANY_CD,SMP_CD,SMP_CHASU,USER_CD,SMP_DRDATE,SMP_DRTYPE,SMP_DRDESCRIPT FROM T_SMP_DROP) AS D LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,SMP_CD,SMP_CHASU,ITEM_CD,CUST_CD,EUSER_CD,BIZ_TYPE,DSTR_TYPE,SMP_RDATE,CMPT_RDATE,PRDT_CDATE,SHIP_PDATE FROM T_SAMPLE WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS S ON D.COMPANY_CD = S.COMPANY_CD AND D.SMP_CD = S.SMP_CD AND D.SMP_CHASU = S.SMP_CHASU LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,ITEM_CD,ITEM_NM,ITEM_TYPE FROM T_ITEM WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS I ON S.COMPANY_CD = I.COMPANY_CD AND S.ITEM_CD = I.ITEM_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,CUST_CD,CUST_NM,BAD_AR_YN FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS C ON S.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND S.CUST_CD = C.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,CUST_CD,CUST_NM FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS C2 ON S.COMPANY_CD = C2.COMPANY_CD AND S.EUSER_CD = C2.CUST_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID, #language# AS CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE') AS CD1 ON S.DSTR_TYPE = CD1.CODE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID, #language# AS CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'BIZ_TYPE') AS CD2 ON S.BIZ_TYPE = CD2.CODE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID, #language# AS CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'SMP_DRTYPE') AS CD3 ON D.SMP_DRTYPE = CD3.CODE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID, #language# AS CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'ITEM_TYPE') AS CD4 ON i.ITEM_TYPE = CD4.CODE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,USER_CD,USER_NM,DEPT_CD FROM T_USER WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS U ON D.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND D.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,DEPT_CD,DEPT_NM,UP_DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) AS DP ON U.COMPANY_CD = DP.COMPANY_CD AND U.DEPT_CD = DP.DEPT_CD
WHERE S.COMPANY_CD IS NOT NULL AND S.SMP_CD IS NOT NULL AND S.SMP_CHASU IS NOT NULL
AND DP.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND DP.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup#
AND S.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND D.USER_CD = #user_nm#
AND D.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND D.SMP_DRDATE >= REPLACE(#sdate#,'-','')
AND D.SMP_DRDATE <= REPLACE(#edate#,'-','')
AND S.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
AND (S.CUST_CD LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%' OR C.CUST_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%') AND S.CUST_CD IS NOT NULL
AND S.BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type#
AND I.ITEM_TYPE = #item_type# AND S.ITEM_CD IS NOT NULL
AND D.SMP_DRTYPE = #smp_drtype#
ORDER BY D.SMP_DRDATE DESC
